transcript.content: Hi there, could you help me get the contractor reconnected quickly? They're experiencing issues logging in. Thank you!

I can help — I just need a couple quick details and your permission to act:

1) Which contractor (name and email)?  
2) Do you want me to:

   - Email IT/support (or our contractor) right away asking to re-enable/reset their account,
   - Or both?

If you want me to send an email, tell me:
- Who should be contacted (IT contact email and/or the contractor email),
- Any message you want included, or I can use a short template like the draft below.

Quick troubleshooting steps you can tell the contractor right now (if you want me to email them, I can include these):
- Try an incognito/private window or clear browser cache & cookies.  
- Use the “Forgot password” link to request a reset (watch spam folder).  
- Confirm they’re using the company domain login (if applicable) and not a personal account.  
- If we use SSO, try signing out of other SSO sessions or restart the browser/device.  
- If they’re remote, confirm VPN is connected if required.  
If these don’t work, account may be disabled/locked and I can contact IT.

Sample email I can send immediately (I’ll customize once you confirm recipients):
Subject: Urgent — Contractor account access issue (please assist)
Body: Hi [IT name]/Team, Our contractor [Name] ([email]) is unable to log in. They’ve tried a password reset and clearing cache but are still blocked. Could you please check if their account is locked or disabled and re-enable/reset access as needed? Please confirm when done or advise next steps. Thanks — [Your name / me@company.com]

Tell me the contractor email and whether to send now; I’ll take care of it.
